ننخلع (form VII)
# نَنْخَلِعُ (nanḵaliʕu) /nan.xa.li.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْخَلَعَ (inḵalaʕa)
# نَنْخَلِعَ (nanḵaliʕa) /nan.xa.li.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَلَعَ (inḵalaʕa)
# نَنْخَلِعْ (nanḵaliʕ) /nan.xa.liʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْخَلَعَ (inḵalaʕa)
